svg.text: Phase 2 · step 7g · The Maintenance tab, redrawn: Schedule, Jobs, and Set up in one tab
The human's direction (2026-11-03): option A's interface, with setting up and tracking maintenance both under the Maintenance tab. A segmented control switches views; Set up only for Maintainers.

+ One tab for maintenance: Schedule to read, Jobs for what was done, Set up to change it.
+ A segmented control, like Settings' You / Household: switching never leaves the tab.
+ Drivers and Viewers see Schedule and Jobs only, so their tab stays simple.
+ Considered: an "Edit schedule" toggle over the cards. Set up has its own lists (turned-off
ones, bundles, removing), so a separate view stays tidier than edit buttons on every card.
− The tab now has its own sub-navigation (one more tap to set up; Set up is rare).
so a link (e.g. from Setup's line) lands on Set up.
